content.scenario: A consumer, Mr. Kumar, purchases a defective refrigerator from a local dealer in Delhi and files a complaint against the manufacturer in the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission of Delhi, seeking compensation and replacement of the product.
content.outcome: The District Commission in Delhi, being a local government body established under sub-section (1) of section 28 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, has the jurisdiction to hear Mr. Kumar's case and provide a resolution to his consumer dispute.
